requirements.RC-1374: Offline-core acceptance requires end-to-end airplane-mode evidence.

startupEvidenceRule: The release startup manifest must bind the checked-out commit SHA to the APK SHA-256, emulator/device identity, airplane/Wi-Fi/mobile-data state, running package PID and crash result. Startup evidence must explicitly keep exercisedCapabilities empty, endToEndCapabilitiesComplete=false and verifiableAsDone=false.
deviceCapabilityEvidenceRule: The Android integration harness must exercise Western/Vedic/Numerology/BaZi/Planetary Hours plus production sqflite records, canonical CSV export/restore, professional-client persistence and production PDF export through the verified packaged Unicode font/render chain while airplane mode, Wi-Fi and mobile data are disabled. The manifest may set endToEndCapabilitiesComplete=true only when all ten capability paths pass and remainingCapabilities is empty. Because Flutter integration_test installs a test artifact rather than exercising the exact release APK, it must still set releaseArtifact=false and verifiableAsDone=false.
lifecycleRule: VERIFIED/DONE requires production instrumentation that exercises all ten listed production capabilities end-to-end on the exact release artifact and records exact artifact/device evidence. Neither release startup smoke nor the test-artifact capability integration harness may substitute for that final proof.
